458275.overview:
Live the life of a Pokémon Trainer in the streets of Lumiose City

Whether you’re a die-hard Pokémon fan or about to toss your first Poké Ball, the Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch 2 game has plenty to offer for Trainers of all types. Experience classic gameplay with modern twists that are sure to revolutionize your Pokémon RPG experience.


Catch, battle, and Mega Evolve—all in real time!

Step onto the battlefield and command your Pokémon directly—there are no turns! For the first time in the Pokémon RPG series, Trainers and their Pokémon can both move around in real-time battles, and your Pokémon will unleash their moves when you tell them to. Strategically swapping out your Pokémon and accounting for each move’s timing and area of effect will greatly help you in this new style of battle.

464825.overview:
Persona 3: Reload is a single-player role-playing game. The story follows a transfer student who arrives at Gekkoukan High School and becomes involved in the hidden “Dark Hour,” a period that exists between one day and the next. Ordinary people are unaware of this time, but those with the ability to wield Personas can fight against the Shadows that emerge. The protagonist joins the Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad (SEES), a small group of students who investigate the Dark Hour while attempting to uncover its origin. At the same time, he must maintain the façade of an ordinary student life, balancing classes, friendships, and daily activities.

Gameplay alternates between two core phases: daily life simulation and dungeon crawling. During the day, the player attends school, chooses how to spend free time, and develops relationships with other characters. These choices affect character growth and the availability of Social Links, which enhance the power of the player’s Personas. At night, the focus shifts to combat within Tartarus, a massive, multi-leveled tower that emerges only during the Dark Hour. Exploration involves ascending procedurally generated floors filled with Shadows to fight and treasures to discover.

Combat uses a turn-based system built around exploiting enemy weaknesses. Striking an opponent with an element they are vulnerable to grants an extra action, and repeated successes allow for an All-Out Attack, a coordinated strike from the entire party. The protagonist can carry multiple Personas, each with unique skills, affinities, and resistances. By fusing Personas together in the Velvet Room, the player can create new, stronger ones, transferring abilities from the originals. Party members gain levels individually and learn new moves as the story progresses. Outside of battle, the player manages resources such as health, magic points, and items. Equipment like weapons, armor, and accessories can be found or purchased, while consumables provide healing or temporary stat boosts. Time management is central, as each day offers only a limited number of activities. Choices about studying, training, or socializing determine how the protagonist develops both academically and personally.

Secondary systems include the Social Link mechanic, which connects the player to various non-playable characters, each tied to an Arcana. As Social Links strengthen, the fusion of Personas from that Arcana produces more powerful results. Dialogue choices influence the pace of these relationships, with some options unlocking romance paths. Mini-games and side activities, such as visiting cafes or working part-time jobs, provide additional benefits and variety. The game also incorporates character dorm life, allowing casual conversations with allies that expand their personalities and provide context for the group’s mission.

464947.overview:
The Ultimate Puzzle Match, now Enhanced
Enter a newly enhanced dimension of puzzle challenge when world-renowned Tetris® and Japan’s beloved Puyo Puyo series blend their legendary gameplay in the ultimate puzzle match. Stack, chain, and combo your way to victory in traditional Puyo Puyo and Tetris… or mix them together in this unique crossover.

- Brand-new Puyo Tetris® Doubles Mode: Compete in 2v2 battles with pairs using a single board to pull off devastating combos.

-Experience a multi-dimensional story in the extensive Adventure mode or compete with friends and family in a bounty of competitive local and online modes featuring support for up to 4 players.

-An absolutely packed roster of 40 playable characters, including Sonic the Hedgehog, each with their own unique stats and abilities you can carry with you into the robust, RPG-inspired Skill Battle mode.

467655.overview:
Pastry Panic! is a co-op dessert factory cooking game. Up to four adorable bunnies team up to mix batter, bake cakes, chop fruit, shave ice, operate machinery… and whatever else the recipes call for!

Hop to it and juggle tasks in a chaotic kitchen, scamper to meet your daily quotas in time and coordinate your team’s efforts to achieve pastry perfection.

Just try to avoid slip-ups, and watch the clock—no bunny likes working overtime!

Features
- Team up in local or online multiplayer for up to four people
- 30+ playable characters to choose from
- Play through 60+ challenging stages
- Process ingredients with over a dozen different machines
- Bake cakes and other tasty delights from lots of different recipes
- Help your team navigate obstacles and the bustle of a factory floor
- Earn stars based on your team’s performance each day
- Coordinate and control two separate bunnies in single-player mode
- Select a “theme” and play in Arcade Mode with teammates from all over the world

467701.overview: Pac-Man is on a brand new adventure and once again dealing with the pesky Ghost Gang. In Pac-Man World 2, the Ghost Gang has picked the magical fruit from an ancient tree, thereby releasing wicked evils upon Pac-Land. You must guide Pac-Man through six new lands with plenty of amusing surprises. New and improved, this Pac-Man can ice skate, rollerblade, submarine dive, and solve many exciting puzzles. With all-new moves and a zany cast of characters, your Pac-Man heroics will be pushed to its limits.

470628.overview:
Shape the world and build a cozy new life with Pokémon

Play as a Ditto that has transformed to look like a human! Find and befriend your fellow Pokémon, carve out a life for yourself, and work together with Professor Tangrowth to build a town for everyone to live in. Learn the moves of your fellow Pokémon to change the land, such as Bulbasaur’s Leafage to make the wild grass grow. You can also use abilities to transform and navigate the world around you, such as crossing water with Lapras’s Surf. As you work to help nature flourish, more Pokémon will appear for you to meet and learn from. You might even encounter a Legendary Pokémon! 

Create habitats, cultivate crops, and more in a world with varied weather and real-time day and nights Gather materials to create items and furniture, till the fields to grow crops and cook them into delicious meals, create habitats for the Pokémon you meet, take photos of fun moments, customize your hairstyle and clothing...there’s so much to do here! No need to rush, though—go at your own pace and enjoy the journey. With a real-time day and night cycle, varying weather, and other surprises, just taking a nap in your bed and letting time pass can be pretty relaxing. 

As your town develops, your fellow Pokémon may also come to you with requests you can fulfill to solve their problems or make the town a more comfortable place to live in. Eventually, you’ll be able to build a nice big home of your own and invite Pokémon to visit. You can also invite up to three other players, via local wireless or online, to visit and hang out together—and each of them can bring a Pokémon along. You can even invite a friend who doesn’t have the game—whether they are on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system or Nintendo Switch—by using GameShare**!
